vehicleBroom.name: Flying broom
vehicleBroom.desc: A broom that answers to nobody's road. It ignores walls, water and cliffs alike, and lands wherever it likes.

vehicleCar.name: Car
vehicleCar.desc: A utilitarian car, parked at the edge of the village. Fast over open ground, and it drinks fuel.

vehicleCamper.name: Camper
vehicleCamper.desc: A van you can live in: a bed, a stove and everything you own, wherever you decide to stop.

vehicleBoat.name: Boat
vehicleBoat.desc: An inflatable dinghy, moored down at the water. Costs nothing to run, and it goes only where there is water.

vehicleBike.name: Bike
vehicleBike.desc: A bicycle, leaning where you left it. No fuel, no upkeep, and it follows every road there is.

vehicleStarship.name: Starship
vehicleStarship.desc: A ship that leaves the ground altogether. No roadside pump will ever fill it.

originDeserter.name: Deserter
originDeserter.desc: Choose a faction you deserted from: begin with 40 of its troops, but hated by it (and its parent faction).

originAugmented.name: Augmented
originAugmented.desc: You all walked out of the same clinic with the hardware still settling: everyone starts with two or three augments, fitted to whatever anatomy they have.

originFactionLeader.name: Faction Leader
originFactionLeader.desc: Choose a faction and begin in command of 40 of its troops, in good standing with it (and its parent faction), with two weeks of upkeep money.

originWarlord.name: Independent Warlord
originWarlord.desc: Begin in command of 40 troops drawn from random factions, loyal to no one, with enough gold to cover two weeks of their upkeep.

originCrash.name: Crash Landed
originCrash.desc: Begin stranded on a random planet in an uncharted galaxy, ship damaged, nearly out of fuel and with no jump charges left.

originArtifact.name: Artifact Heir
originArtifact.desc: Inherit one of the world's ancient artifacts, chosen at random, along with its history.

originCeo.name: CEO
originCeo.desc: Start rich: €1,000,000 in cash and an 80% controlling stake in LimeCorp, at its headquarters.

originBunker.name: Bunker
originBunker.desc: Wake up in a stocked loot cellar under a random overland biome. Its gold is yours, and the hatch you climb out of stays open forever.

originStranded.name: Stranded
originStranded.desc: Begin on foot at a random remote spot, far from anywhere anyone would look.

originCriminal.name: Criminal
originCriminal.desc: Same camper start as the camper origin, but your party begins already wanted with a 10,000€ bounty.

originMayor.name: Mayor
originMayor.desc: Pick a city, then begin there with 50 of every crafting material.

originDungeon.name: Dungeon entrance
originDungeon.desc: Start at the tower gate with a delve kit: extra potions, the tower routes map, a flashlight and a climbing rope.

originLot.name: Full automation
originLot.desc: Build your utopia: every party member starts with advanced crafting specializations, and the workshop is already fully stocked. The machines will do the rest - all you need is the vision.

originBike.name: Start on bike
originBike.desc: Begin out in the country with a bike parked beside you.

originCar.name: Start in car
originCar.desc: Wake up out in the country beside your car, keys in hand. Where you drive it is up to you.

originCamper.name: Start in camper
originCamper.desc: Wake up out in the country beside your camper, keys in hand. Where you drive it is up to you.

originSpace.name: Start in space
originSpace.desc: Skip the map selection and begin your journey out in space.

originTrain.name: Start in train
originTrain.desc: Board the train and pick your destination on the map (default).

rerollCharacter.name: Reroll character
rerollCharacter.desc: Randomize this character again and update the dossier.

ageElder.name: Elder (60+)
ageElder.desc: Old, have lived through the Psichic Wars.

randomTraits.name: Randomize traits
randomTraits.desc: Have traits randomly assigned to your character.

randomPersonality.name: Random
randomPersonality.desc: Let a disposition be dealt to your character.

randomClass.name: Random class
randomClass.desc: Be assigned a random starting class.

selectClass.name: Select a class
selectClass.desc: Choose your starting class from a list of archetypes.

randomizeAllParty.name: Randomize all party
randomizeAllParty.desc: Fill every party slot with a random character instantly, then choose your origin.

totalRandom.name: Total Random
totalRandom.desc: Create a completely random character instantly.

newCharacter.name: Create New Character
newCharacter.desc: Create a brand new character from scratch.

hometownPick.name: Pick on map
hometownPick.desc: Choose your hometown from the map.

combatMonsters.name: Monsters
combatMonsters.desc: Capture and battle with monsters. \C[1]This cannot be changed later.\C[0]

combatMap.name: Map Battle
combatMap.desc: Tactical fights on the live map instead of a separate battle screen. Move on the tile grid, weapons and skills have a reach, and line of sight matters. Can be changed later in Options.

combatRpg.name: Classic RPG
combatRpg.desc: Standard turn-based combat. Skills cost MP/AP and are picked from your command menu.

peaceful.name: Peaceful
peaceful.desc: Enemies never attack or chase you unless provoked, and you can \C[1]Talk\C[0] to them in battle. Defeat just returns you to your last respawn point.

bloodAndOil.name: Blood and Oil
bloodAndOil.desc: A slashing blow can take a body part off for good, with permanent stat debuffs; a part it only breaks still heals. Losing a vital organ kills the character instantly. Allies not resurrected by the end of the battle die permanently.

permadeath.name: Permadeath
permadeath.desc: If your character perishes in battle you must create a new one. Allies not resurrected by the end of the battle die permanently.

roguelite.name: Roguelite
roguelite.desc: If defeated you rewake at the base floor of the dungeon. Fallen allies stay in the party and can be resurrected after battle.

originCardCollector.name: Card Collector
originCardCollector.desc: You came off the circuit with a shelf of monster cards and a deck already sleeved. Everyone you meet is somebody who might sit down for a game.

originArcanist.name: Arcanist
originArcanist.desc: You left the college with four esoteric spells apiece, a shelf of school primers, a beginner's grimoire and robes that still smell of chalk. Pick where the coach sets you down.

originMercenary.name: Mercenary
originMercenary.desc: The last contract paid in kit rather than coin: a ranged weapon each, a field vest, a medic's bag and whatever survival gear was left in the truck. Pick where the work takes you.

originLostConvoker.name: Lost Convoker
originLostConvoker.desc: The rite worked. It just did not say where. You come to in a field, a forest or a mountainside nobody chose, with eight summoning rites apiece, a staff, a robe and no idea which country this is.

originSkeletonKey.name: Skeleton Key Holder
originSkeletonKey.desc: You own one thing, and it opens any mundane lock ever cut. No rations, no bedroll, no lamp: whatever you need is already behind somebody's door. Pick the place on the map where you start trying them.

originPlague.name: Plague Spreader
originPlague.desc: You escaped a biolab with a case full of sealed vials holding the worst pathogens that ever existed.

originDiplomat.name: Diplomat
originDiplomat.desc: Begin in Brussels with an ONU Terminal, remote access into the assembly. No rations, no rope: a seat at the table is the only thing you brought.

originHypernetExplorer.name: Hypernet Explorer
originHypernetExplorer.desc: You come round at a terminal in the Hypernet Point with a bag of components, an energy drink and no memory of paying for the hour. The deck is half built. The rest of it is out there somewhere, in shops, in skips, and in other people's houses.

statInfo.HP: Health Points. Falls to 0 and the character is knocked out of the fight.
statInfo.MP: Mana Points. Spent to cast skills and spells; empty and only free actions are left.
statInfo.STR: Strength. Drives physical attack power, melee and thrown weapons alike.
statInfo.CON: Constitution. Physical defense: how much a hit's damage is shaved down before it lands.
statInfo.DEX: Dexterity. Turn order and the odds of dodging an attack outright.
statInfo.INT: Intelligence. Drives magic attack power, the damage a spell actually lands for.
statInfo.WIS: Wisdom. Magic defense: resistance to spells and other magical harm.
statInfo.PSI: Psyche. Luck: critical hits, rare drops and other odds tipped in the character's favor.
statInfo.ARCANE: Arcane. How magical the character looks and feels to anyone reading them.
statInfo.SUBSTANCE: Substance. How stylish the character is, the impression their look leaves.
statInfo.STEALTH: Stealth. How well the character blends into the surroundings.
statInfo.INTIMIDATION: Intimidation. How threatening the character's clothes and gear appear.
